name: scan_markets
title: Scan live markets
description: Discover open Polymarket markets (ordered by 24h volume), inspect a bounded sample and rank them by quoted spread, then top-of-book size. Live public GET requests only, capped by maxRequests and maxDurationMs. Returns ranked candidates, why the others were not ranked, full accounting and whether the scan was partial. Candidates are research leads, not opportunities: a spread is not a profit.

version.description: Protocol version of the markets to discover.

maxMarkets.description: Eligible markets to inspect (3 requests each).

maxPages.description: Discovery pages to fetch at most.

minTopSize.description: Minimum of best bid size and best ask size, in shares.

includeSuspicious.description: Rank books with nonfatal quality issues too.

depthBand.description: Price band for depth near the best price, or null.

maxRequests.description: Hard cap on HTTP attempts for this call, retries included.

name: inspect_market
title: Inspect one live market
description: Fetch one market by Gamma id and both outcome order books (at most 4 public GET requests, 8 attempts with retries, 20 s). Validates eligibility and the explicit outcome-to-asset association, then reports per-outcome book quality, metrics, best levels, server timestamps and request provenance. status 'invalid_book' means a book failed validation; its evidence is still returned.

marketId.description: Gamma market id, e.g. from scan_markets.

levels.description: Aggregated price levels per side to return, best first.

depthBand.description: Price band for depth near the best price, or null.

name: list_collection_runs
title: List stored collection runs
description: List recent local collection runs (newest first) with status, accounting, versions, counts and source type. Offline: reads the local database only. Runs recovered after a crash have accounting 'incomplete' (null counts are unknown); an unverifiable running run is reported, never changed.

limit.description: Most recent collection runs to return.

name: get_market_history
title: Get stored market history
description: Stored observations of one market and sample-count statistics (spread min/median/max, current vs previous, threshold share, gaps). Offline. asOf filters by evidence availability, so nothing observed later is used. Statistics use every usable sample in the analysis window; limit only trims the listed rows. status 'no_history' means insufficient evidence. Use observationId with get_observation_details.

asOf.description: Evidence-availability boundary (inclusive), ISO-8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-10-29T08:00:00Z. Nothing that became available later is used.

limit.description: Most recent observations to list. Statistics always use the whole analysis window.

spreadThreshold.description: Spread threshold for the share-of-samples statistic.

analyticsVersion.description: Metrics version to use; versions are never mixed.

name: get_observation_details
title: Get stored observation evidence
description: Full stored evidence for one observation: market and outcome identity, exact captured price levels (wire order), book quality and issues, request timing and server timestamps, availability time and pair skew, and every stored metrics version. Offline. With asOf, the observation must have been available by then and later facts are withheld.

asOf.description: Evidence-availability boundary (inclusive), ISO-8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-10-29T08:00:00Z. Nothing that became available later is used.

levels.description: Captured price levels per side to return, in wire order.
